arrow_straight_up_1000x528.desc: Straight arrow, 1000 long: head 317 long and 528 across, shaft 683 long tapering from 120 at the head to 140 at the tail (per detail), R24 (typ.) on all corners. Grid 500.
arrow_straight_up_1000x528.trace_note: traced from GE1-14 (rotated drawing), see GE1-14

notes: Drawing shows two signs drawn rotated 90 degrees (legend reads upward); transcribed in the sign's own frame. Upper sign (fully dimensioned): 4420 x 3155 R300, green 70 / white 70. Vertical chain 440 | 400 E | 300 | 70 white divider | 430 | 1000 arrow | 515 = 3155. Along the sign: 460 | 3500 | 460 = 4420 for the two arrows, read as edge-to-outer-edge of each 528-wide arrow. 'M3 City' is drawn centred on the sign (the picture; the 460 dims belong to the arrows) with the 400 gap from the top chain: M3 780.4 + 400 + City 1264.5 = 2444.9 centred -> M3 x 987.6, City x 2168. FLAG: the lower sign (M80 RING RD Geelong / Seymour with three arrows) has 'Varies' for its width and text positions and is not transcribed; its RING RD panel detail: 600 high, R100, 300 E black, 150 margins. The drawing is rotated, so the arrow symbol is traced from the rotated image (see the symbols entry).
